reviews.title: Really, really nice!
reviews.comment: This is an awesome case! My last case was a Corsair Carbide Series Air 540 White, so I wanted to give the vertical liquid cooled design a try and I’m impressed! Running a Ryzen 7800X3D and 5080 - Cyberpunk 2077 maxed out 1440p barely makes the the cpu and gpu reach 55C. They barely hit 70C @ 4k. The space for a full 360 AIO cooler, two 160mm lower case fans, three 120mm front/side fans, and one 140mm fans in so many different configs is awesome. You’ll be able to find your sweet spot regardless of your setup. The preinstalled cable management into the case gives you an idea of how the flow of wires should or could go. Very helpful for new builders and vets alike. The case comes with extra Velcro straps and zip ties. It also includes a tool kit for your screws. For being essentially only tempered glass and shell mesh, it’s quite sturdy and rigid. I never feel like I have to be gentle with it. Dust could be a problem as there is only one dust filter on the bottom. Overall this is a great case with a lot of space and well thought out engineering for gamers.

reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: Great case, maybe skip the fans
reviews.comment: This case is very well designed, looks great and has really high build quality. Building in this is very easy. All of the panels come off as you would expect, all of them feel very sturdy. There is a lot of room to work in and build in. I bought the ARGB version, which comes with the fans. I would not due so if I were to buy it again. The fans work great and move a ton of air. I really like the 160mm reverse blade bottom fans. However, both of the bottom fans made a high pitched humming sound when above 40% fan speed and the 140mm exhaust fan made a rattling noise. Antec customer service was super responsive and sent me out replacement fans 2 day air from Taiwan. Unfortunately the new bottom fans also made the same noise. In the end I bought 3 140mm reverse blade fans to replace them. Maybe yours won't make the noise, or you won't be sensitive to it, but I would just buy the version without fans and choose your own. For anyone wondering, the bottom and top will fit 3 120 or 140mm fans or 2 160mm fans. It will fit a 360mm radiator, but not most 420s. The side will fit 3 120mm fans or 3 140mm fans if you either don't screw in the top two screws on the top 140 or drill holes in the case for those screws. I have 140mm Uni Fans that connect together mounted there, so I didn't feel the need to put in the top two screws. The bottom air filter is a fine screen and blocks dust well, but is very delicate and has no bracing, so be gentle with it. It takes up the entire bottom, so you can't really have anything standing there if it's not already covered by fans. The side intake is just small holes in the panel. I know those are in style now, but they are still a lot larger than the screen filter and let in a lot more dust, so I wish there was a screen filter there as well. All in all I love the case and if I had bought the one without the fans I would give it 5 stars.
reviews.author: Jaethos

reviews.title: quality case, roomy, cable management, drive capacity
reviews.comment: awesome case, glad to see Antec back in the game. My last Antec case is 12 years old and still no rust, in an island environment. plenty of room for drives in the back (4ssd and 2hdd), good cable management, great thick glass panels. the 160mm fans on bottom keep my 3080ti at 50c during gaming, lol!

reviews.title: A case offering an easy build while looking good to boot.
reviews.comment: This case has been an excellent case. It’s easy to build in and fairly priced $150 w/fans. Though I would buy without fan next time as I switched to 3x 140mm bottom and rear, 120mm every where else. LIAN Li fans. Low resistance for airflow. Keeps the 9950x3d and 5090 cool while offering a clean look.
